argv:
set -euo pipefail
export PYTHONPATH=.
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
/root/.local/share/uv/tools/nht/bin/python - <<'PY'
import sys, runpy, json
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, "knowledge/runs/run-player-prefix-approximation-20261108")
m=runpy.run_path("knowledge/runs/run-player-prefix-approximation-20261108/probe.py")
g=m["large_gaussian"].__globals__
scene=Path("tmp/player-prefix-assets/scenes/B00/reconstruction/export/scene.json")
nht=g["nht"]
validated=nht.load_validated_scene_export(scene,without_source_images=True)
renderer=nht.ResidentSceneRenderer(validated.checkpoint_path,validated.runtime_config)
output=Path("outputs/synthetic_data_generation/profile/player-prefix-approximation/stress-diagnostic")
output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
records=[]
original=g["rasterization"]
current=[None]
def observed(**kwargs):
    kwargs["scales"]=kwargs["scales"].clone()
    kwargs["scales"][1,:2]=current[0]
    result=original(**kwargs)
    alpha=result[1]
    records.append({"sheet_xy":current[0],"far":kwargs["far_plane"],"alpha_min":float(alpha.min()),"alpha_max":float(alpha.max()),"zero_samples":int((alpha==0).sum()),"finite":bool(alpha.isfinite().all())})
    return result
g["rasterization"]=observed
results=[]
for xy in (5,10,20,40,100):
    current[0]=xy
    trial=output/str(xy)
    trial.mkdir()
    try:
        result=m["large_gaussian"](renderer,trial)
    except ValueError as error:
        result={"error":str(error)}
    results.append({"sheet_xy":xy,"result":result})
report={"native":records,"trials":results}
(output/"metrics.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(report))
PY
